facts.text: Omni Nashville Hotel is in downtown Nashville and is connected to the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum.
facts.excerpt: Omni Nashville Hotel is located in downtown Nashville on Fifth Avenue, between Demonbreun and Korean Veterans Boulevard and connected to the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum.

facts.text: The hotel is centrally located near Broadway, with convenient access to Ryman Auditorium, Music City Center, Bridgestone Arena and the Johnny Cash Museum.
facts.excerpt: is centrally located near Broadway, and also offers convenient access to Ryman Auditorium, Music City Center, Bridgestone Arena, and the Johnny Cash Museum.

facts.text: The hotel is about 0.5 miles from the Ryman Auditorium.
facts.excerpt: Omni Nashville Hotel is near the Ryman Auditorium (0.5 miles from the hotel)

facts.text: The hotel is 8 miles, approximately 20 minutes, from Nashville International Airport.
facts.excerpt: Omni Nashville Hotel is located 8 miles (approximately 20 minutes) from Nashville International Airport (BNA).

facts.text: The hotel has a heated rooftop pool.
facts.excerpt: A heated rooftop pool

facts.text: The rooftop pool is only available to Omni guests.
facts.excerpt: The rooftop pool, only available to Omni guests, is worth a visit, even if it's not warm enough to don a bathing suit.

facts.text: The full-service Mokara Spa offers a full suite of services in addition to yoga classes.
facts.excerpt: The full-service Mokara Spa is one of the prettiest in Nashville, offering a full suite of services, in addition to yoga classes.

facts.text: Deluxe Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of downtown Nashville.
facts.excerpt: The floor to ceiling windows offer a breathtaking view of downtown Nashville.

facts.text: Suites have dedicated living spaces and a separate king bedroom.
facts.excerpt: boast dedicated living spaces, separate king bedroom and unparalleled comfort.

facts.text: Rooms use dark colors, bold patterns and luxe materials.
facts.excerpt: dark colors, bold patterns, and luxe materials are used throughout.

facts.text: Premier rooms or suites on floors 14 and above have views of downtown and the city skyline.
facts.excerpt: Book a premier room or suite on floors 14 and above for superb views of downtown and the city skyline.

facts.text: Suites have soaking tubs overlooking the city.
facts.excerpt: suites have soaking tubs overlooking the city.

facts.text: The Johnny Cash Museum Personal Tour is an Omni Signature Experience that starts with breakfast alongside the museum's curator.
facts.excerpt: Step into the world of Johnny Cash with a personal museum tour, starting with breakfast alongside the museum's curator.

facts.text: Kitchen Notes serves traditional southern dishes and home-cooked meals, including a biscuit bar.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy traditional southern dishes and authentic home-cooked meals, including our famous biscuit bar at our Nashville, Tennessee hotel.

facts.text: Guests can shop for local goods at Five and TENN.
facts.excerpt: shop for local goods at Five and TENN

facts.text: Bob's Steak & Chop House is a restaurant at the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel is a 21-story building attached to the Music City Center.
facts.excerpt: Business travelers frequent this 21-story hotel, attached to the Music City Center.

facts.text: The hotel is pet friendly for pets under 25 pounds, with a one-time non-refundable pet fee.
facts.excerpt: Omni Nashville Hotel is a pet friendly hotel for pets under 25 pounds. There is a one-time non-refundable pet fee of $125 per reservation.

facts.text: Self-parking and valet parking are available with a nightly charge.
facts.excerpt: Self-parking and valet parking with a nightly charge

facts.text: The hotel is popular with convention and trade show attendees.
